sql: SELECT trip_date, avg_total_amount, avg_trip_distance, CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN 'target' ELSE 'baseline' END AS period_type FROM whybot.yellow_daily WHERE dayofweek(trip_date) = 5 AND trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-07' AND DATE '2024-12-05' ORDER BY trip_date LIMIT 500
